labels.text: Section 45R(d)(3)(B): the dollar amount used under section 45R(c)(2) (the average-annual-wages phaseout fraction) and section 45R(d)(1)(B) (twice this amount is the average-annual-wage eligibility ceiling). Section 45R(d)(3)(B)(i) fixes $25,000 for taxable years beginning in 2010-2013; (d)(3)(B)(ii) indexes it for later years by the section 1(f)(3) cost-of-living adjustment. An indexed year is pinned only where the Revenue Procedure publishing it is pinned in us.irc.inflation_adjustments (2025: Rev. Proc. 2024-40; 2026: Rev. Proc. 2025-32). Years 2014-2024 and 2027 onward remain gaps between the anchored rows: evaluation returns MISSING_PARAMETER_VALUE rather than a fabricated indexed figure. See TECH-GAPS.md G391.
section 45R(d)(3)(B)(i): 'the dollar amount in effect under this paragraph for taxable years beginning in 2010, 2011, 2012, or 2013 is $25,000'
Rev. Proc. 2024-40 section 2.10: 'For taxable years beginning in 2025, the dollar amount in effect under section 45R(d)(3)(B) is $33,300'
Rev. Proc. 2025-32 section 4.09: 'For taxable years beginning in 2026, the dollar amount in effect under section 45R(d)(3)(B) is $34,100'
